issue: No licence exists to use NFL data for wagering analytics.
why_flagged: NFL.com Terms and Conditions §1.3 (read 2026-11-13) limits use to 'individual non-commercial and informational purposes' and prohibits 'systematic retrieval of data ... to create or compile ... a collection, compilation, database' without express prior written consent.
what_was_tried: Read the terms page and quoted the operative sentence verbatim on the sources page.
remediation: Request written consent or a licence (Q-01, Q-22). Until then no price or model output may be used for wagering.

issue: No licensed market price anywhere in the pack.
why_flagged: Every market_spread, market_total, market_ml, edge, ROI and CLV cell would have to be invented. They are blank.
what_was_tried: Searched the repo for any committed sportsbook archive: none. No price was manufactured.
remediation: Buy a timestamped closing-line archive (Q-03) before any strategy is evaluated (VG-03).
source_label: NFL.com schedules (slate identity only, no prices)

issue: Every correlation coefficient in the register is blank.
why_flagged: Correlations require paired outcomes; the repo holds only season totals per club, which cannot produce a paired sample.
what_was_tried: Registered eight pairs with pre-registered signs and a named method, and left every coefficient blank.
remediation: License paired game-level and player-game history and run the registered method (Q-11, VG-10).

issue: Both known NFL injury-report policy URLs return HTTP 404.
why_flagged: operations.nfl.com/media/2683/2017-nfl-injury-report-policy.pdf and operations.nfl.com/the-rules/nfl-injury-report-policy/ were fetched on 2026-11-13 and returned a 404 page titled 'FLAG ON THE PLAY'. Earlier sessions cited the first URL as a verified source.
what_was_tried: Fetched both URLs, recorded the 404 verbatim, and removed reliance on them. The 90-minute inactive deadline is therefore NOT cited to an official page here.
remediation: Ask NFL Football Operations for the current policy text (Q-04). Do not restore the dead link.

issue: The luck-vs-skill test is specified but cannot produce a number.
why_flagged: Any numeric 'P(profit > 0)' or variance figure needs a price and a settled history. Computing one from nothing would be fabrication.
what_was_tried: Specified the test, its pre-registered threshold and the gate that blocks it (VG-07); left the value blank rather than estimating it.
remediation: Supply licensed prices, then run the pre-registered test.

issue: Only 12 of the 28 clubs on the Week 10 injury report have a depth chart read; the other 16 stay blank.
why_flagged: The league publishes injury statuses and the clubs publish charts, but no single official page joins them. Charts were read for AZ, BAL, DET, GB, IND, KC, LV, MIA, MIN, NE, PIT, SEA; the remaining clubs would require a page this session did not read, so their string and deficiency cells are blank rather than guessed.
what_was_tried: Read 12 official club depth-chart pages directly. Houston's page serves the chart as an image and could not be transcribed, so it stays uncharted rather than guessed.
remediation: Read the remaining club charts, or accept a partial join and read the counts as conditional on the charted subset.

issue: 10 of the 12 club depth charts carry no publication timestamp; the 2 that do are dated but still labelled unofficial.
why_flagged: A chart is a snapshot with no version history. The dated ones (GB Nov 10, 2026; LV November 10, 2026) can be placed in a week; the rest cannot, so a name's string could predate the injury that displaced him.
what_was_tried: Checked every chart page for a date line, a 'last updated' stamp or a week marker. Where one existed it is recorded in the chart registry (src/nfl_wk/depth.py, as_of field) and published on the injuries page.
remediation: Re-read each chart immediately before kickoff and record the fetch time, or license a chart feed with version history.

issue: 4 injury-report names would not match a club chart string-for-string; 3 were joined by a documented alias and 1 has no chart to join to, so it stays blank.
why_flagged: A near-match could be two different players, and one alias (Drew Ogletree) points at a club whose chart was not read in this session, so it is listed but not applied. Every alias is published with both spellings so a reviewer can reject any of them individually.
what_was_tried: Exact normalised match first; only unmatched names were considered for the alias table, and an alias is only applied when the club's chart is actually on file.
published_value: BAL Matthew Hibner = Matt Hibner; BAL Olaivavega Ioane = Vega Ioane; IND A.J. Haulcy = AJ Haulcy (all applied); IND Drew Ogletree = Andrew Ogletree (not applied: no IND chart)
remediation: Reject any alias that looks wrong; the affected row then becomes an unmatched, blank row rather than a wrong join.

issue: 17 injured players appear on the official report but not on their club's chart at all.
why_flagged: The chart may be stale, may omit practice-squad players, or the spelling may differ beyond the alias list. Their string is left blank rather than inferred.
what_was_tried: Matched on full name and on normalised name; checked the position group the injury report states. No player was force-matched.
published_value: AZ Zachary Carter; AZ Hunter Long; BAL Adam Randall; DET Kerby Joseph; GB Chris Brooks; GB Skyy Moore; GB Micah Parsons; GB Trey Smack; IND Arden Key; IND Luke Rhodes; KC Omarr Norman-Lott; LV Foley Fatukasi; MIA Tucker Addington; MIA Darrell Baker Jr.; NE Reggie Gilliam; NE Greg Van Roten; PIT Derrick Harmon
remediation: Confirm each against the club's roster page at kickoff; until then the row carries no string.

issue: The injury report snapshot has no publication timestamp.
why_flagged: nfl.com/injuries shows the report but not when it was generated, and the page is re-rendered as practice reports arrive. A status read now may be one practice old.
what_was_tried: Recorded read_on = 2026-11-13 for every row and refused to claim a report timestamp.
remediation: Capture with HTTP Date and hash on a schedule (SG-07, Q-05).

issue: The originated line has no home-field advantage and no opponent adjustment.
why_flagged: The model uses only each club's season points-for and points-against per game from the official standings. Adding a home-field parameter would be inventing a number the official page does not publish.
what_was_tried: Disclosed both omissions in the model page, the own_lines flags column and here.
remediation: Decide whether to fit a home-field term from official results (Q-14) and license play-by-play for opponent adjustment (Q-13).

issue: The league-wide scoring spread is a model assumption, not an official statistic.
why_flagged: The single-game margin sigma (5.90) is derived as sqrt(2) x the standard deviation of club points per game. No official NFL page publishes a margin standard deviation.
what_was_tried: Labelled the aggregate 'model assumption' in the table and repeated it here.
remediation: Replace with a fitted value once a licensed game-level archive exists.

issue: No strategy has a single settled bet.
why_flagged: All eleven strategies are hypotheses. The leaderboard has no qualified entry and no research units are awarded.
what_was_tried: Ran the gate engine, which fails closed and returned 0/12 gates for every strategy.
remediation: Collect licensed data and run the pre-registered tests.
